fullTextZH: 对孙悟空做了很多事情。
fullTextEN: Did many things to Sun Wukong.
For example, using a knife to chop him,
Using lightning to strike him.

fullTextZH: 后来把他放在一个很热很热的炉子里，
fullTextEN: Later put him in a very hot furnace,
Wanted to burn him to death.
Hello everyone!
I am Teacher Wang.
I come from Henan, China.
Where is Henan?
Henan is in central China.
What does Henan have?
Henan has the Shaolin Temple,
Henan has Chinese Kung Fu.
Welcome to Henan!

fullTextZH: 今天我要给大家带来一只猴子的故事。
fullTextEN: Today I want to bring you a story about a monkey.
Its name is Sun Wukong.
A long, long time ago,

fullTextZH: 在一个很远很远的海边，
fullTextEN: At a very distant seaside,
There was a mountain.

fullTextZH: 山上有一个巨大的石头。
fullTextEN: On the mountain, there was a huge rock.
One day, I heard a 'bang' sound,
The stone exploded.

fullTextZH: 从里面跳出了一只猴子。
fullTextEN: A monkey jumped out from inside.

fullTextZH: 这只猴子有着金黄色的毛发，
fullTextEN: This monkey had golden yellow fur,
with big eyes,
very beautiful.
It was very smart and capable.

fullTextZH: 山上的猴子就让它做首领。
fullTextEN: The monkeys on the mountain made it the leader.
What is a leader?
A leader is like a king,
everyone listens to him.

fullTextZH: 有一天，山上的一只老猴子死了，
fullTextEN: One day, an old monkey on the mountain died,
everyone was very sad.

fullTextZH: 一只小猴子说：“是不是有一天我们都会死呢？”
fullTextEN: A little monkey said, 'Will we all die one day?'
Everyone was very worried after hearing this.
Sun Wukong was also very worried.
He wanted to go out and learn skills,
to make himself stronger.

fullTextZH: 第二天，他就出去学本领了。
fullTextEN: The next day, he went out to learn skills.

fullTextZH: 他在一个地方遇到一位老师。
fullTextEN: He met a teacher in a place.
This place is a Taoist temple.

fullTextZH: 这位老师教给他两个本领。
fullTextEN: This teacher taught him two skills.
The first is the 72 transformations,

fullTextZH: 它能变成很多很多种样子。
fullTextEN: It can transform into many, many forms.
It can turn into a person,
It can also turn into an animal,
It can also turn into things.

fullTextZH: 比如，可以变成一位老人，
fullTextEN: For example, it can turn into an old man,
It can turn into a fish,
It can turn into a peach,
It can turn into a cabinet,
It can also turn into a house.
There are many, many kinds of transformations.
The second skill is the somersault cloud.
It flips one somersault for 54,000 kilometers,
About more than one circle around the Earth.

fullTextZH: 后来，它又得到一个秘密武器，
fullTextEN: Later, it got another secret weapon,
called the Golden Cudgel.
What is the Golden Cudgel?

fullTextZH: 就是一根很特别很特别的棍子。
fullTextEN: It's a very, very special stick.
This stick weighs 13,500 jin,
Very heavy, very heavy.

fullTextZH: 有时候，孙悟空会让他变得很小很小，
fullTextEN: Sometimes, Sun Wukong would make it very small,

fullTextZH: 放在自己的耳朵里，用的时候会让他变大。
fullTextEN: put it in his ear, and make it big when needed.

fullTextZH: 有了本领和武器的孙悟空变得非常强大了。
fullTextEN: With skills and weapons, Sun Wukong became very powerful.
At that time,
there were also some people living in the sky,
these people were called immortals.
Immortals are different from humans.
Humans can die,
immortals cannot.

fullTextZH: 他们还有很多特别的能力。
fullTextEN: They also have many special abilities.

fullTextZH: 神仙希望所有人都听他们的话。
fullTextEN: Immortals want everyone to listen to them.

fullTextZH: 神仙给了孙悟空一个工作，
fullTextEN: Immortals gave Sun Wukong a job,
hoping he would obey.

fullTextZH: 但是孙悟空和别人不一样，
fullTextEN: But Sun Wukong is different from others,
he did not work well,

fullTextZH: 对神仙们做的事情很不满意。
fullTextEN: and was very dissatisfied with what the immortals did.
One day,

fullTextZH: 神仙们要开一个生日派对。
fullTextEN: the immortals wanted to hold a birthday party.

fullTextZH: 所有的东西都准备好了，
fullTextEN: Everything is ready,

fullTextZH: 可是孙悟空拿着他的金箍棒，把房间里的桌子、椅子、碗、盘子、杯子都打翻了。
fullTextEN: But Sun Wukong, holding his golden staff, overturned all the tables, chairs, bowls, plates, and cups in the room.
The immortals were very angry,

fullTextZH: 对孙悟空做了很多事情。
fullTextEN: and did many things to Sun Wukong.
For example, they tried to cut him with a knife,
strike him with lightning,

fullTextZH: 后来把他放在一个很热很热的炉子里，
fullTextEN: and later put him in a very hot furnace,
trying to burn him to death.

fullTextZH: 但是学了本领的孙悟空好好的。
fullTextEN: But Sun Wukong, who had learned skills, was fine.

fullTextZH: 这些人看到孙悟空那么强大，
fullTextEN: These people saw Sun Wukong so powerful,
and they were both afraid and angry.

fullTextZH: 他们找了一个更厉害的神仙来帮忙。
fullTextEN: They found a more powerful immortal to help.

fullTextZH: 这位神仙把一座大山压在了孙悟空身上。
fullTextEN: This immortal pressed a large mountain onto Sun Wukong.

fullTextZH: 孙悟空的身体不能动了。
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong's body couldn't move.

fullTextZH: 它会一直压在大山下面吗？
fullTextEN: Will it always be pressed under the mountain?
Next time, I'll tell you.
Goodbye!
